_about: Stores the local catalog index reads (catalog_match/sitemaps.py, scripts/build_catalog_index.py).
product_path: a regular expression the PATH of a product page matches. The patterns come from the
product pages the live runs of 2026-10-03 found (runs/2026-10-03/smoke_*.json). The sitemap
locations are not known yet: run 'python scripts/build_catalog_index.py --discover' and adjust
sitemaps / sitemap_include from what it prints. A store whose page slugs often leave out the brand
(noon, Union Coop) is disabled: the index finds rows by the brand's words.
sitemap_hosts (optional): other hosts that serve the store's sitemaps (a CDN its robots.txt points to);
their files are read, but product pages still have to be on 'hosts'.

stores.name: Sharjah Co-op
stores.note: e.g. /en/dahabi-slicesd-bread-brown-700g/p/9501100306746 (English pages only: the Product-ar sitemaps repeat the same products; loose items have ids like D000000000002). robots.txt asks for a 10 second Crawl-delay (kept: about 16 requests, 3 minutes) and Visit-time 0400-0845 UTC (kept: outside that window the store is skipped for the refresh, asked again at the next one)
